$comment: Logical binding between OM group policy state and MLS epoch transitions.

GroupControlTransition.previous_mls_epoch: MLS epoch expected by the transition
GroupControlTransition.resulting_group_state_hash: canonical resulting OM group-policy state hash
GroupControlTransition.conversation_id: stable Room ConversationID; the same provider-independent ID used by ConversationEvent

Rule: Membership-affecting OM state and MLS state may not silently commit independently.
